'''Operation Vanity''' was an [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] operation during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The events of the operation were considered an anomaly to Intelligence, and it was not until years later that they discovered the involvement of the [[Star Cabal]] in the operation.
